text: When an edited attendee address differs only in case, the dialog lowercases both parsed mailbox keys and the existing attendee email lookup. A match retains the current attendee object, updates its common name and removes that map entry before creating extra rows. This preserves role and participation state on that path; the test checks one attendee with DECLINED and CHAIR. New rows use lowercased map keys, while organizer comparison had a separate later change. This is a local dialog contract, not a global email-normalization rule or a fresh UI result.
title: Attendee row matching lowercases both lookup keys while retaining the existing attendee
